generationInputs.prompt: The image shows a stylized design incorporating agricultural elements. On the right side, completing the heart shape, is a stylized shaft of wheat, depicted in shades of light brown and gold. Inside this heart shape are four individual fruit shapes, each a different color. The top fruit is green and round, resembling an avocado and oriented diagonally from the upper left to the lower right. Below and slightly to the left of the avocado is a yellow elongated fruit resembling a banana, pointing upwards and slightly to the left. A blue round fruit resembling a plum is positioned centrally, pointing downwards and slightly to the left. To the right of the plum is a red round fruit resembling an apple, oriented horizontally with its tip pointing towards the right. A thin, light green stem extends from the bottom of the plum and extends downwards, partially obscured by the apple. The entire design is set against a plain white background. The style is flat and graphic, with solid colors and no shading or texture visible.
